fresh_court.identity_rule: exact Cartesian product of the four locked families and integer indices 40..79; parent and successor must be evaluated on the exact same identities; no omission, substitution or duplicate

promotion_gate.rationale: R2 exists specifically to improve public-transition and hidden-goal reasoning over the accepted frozen parent. Promotion therefore requires a strict total gain, a strict implicit-goal gain, and zero solved-count regression in every other family on the identical untouched fresh court.

post_fresh_rule.failure_path: record the negative result, create a new candidate, and reserve a new untouched fresh block; never retune against or reuse fresh:40..79 for promotion

claim_boundary: This preregistration defines the promotion decision before fresh:40..79 is opened. It does not itself authorize fresh evaluation; exact candidate reproducibility and PRE_FRESH_LOCK authority are still required.
